The '''CS-1 Cargo Sled''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] jointly produced by the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] and [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] for exclusive sale with the [[E-9 Explorer-class armed long range scout vessel|E-9 Explorer]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]].

==Characteristics==
The CS-1's front quarter was dominated by a four-person cab. The rest of the vehicle's 8-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] length consisted of an open-air bed capable of carrying up to 1,000 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo. The CS-1 prioritized power over speed, and its cargo capacity met the needs of most owners, though a few attempted to upgrade the vehicle's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] unit to carry more, rarely with any success. A few owners were able to install weaponry such as a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] in the bed in order to protect cargo in less civilized regions.<ref name="METOSP4" />

==History==
The CS-1 was made exclusively for sale with [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation's]] [[E-9 Explorer-class armed long range scout vessel|E-9 Explorer]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]]. While designing a repulsorlift vehicle to complement the E-9, Loronar, who were inexperienced in this area, partnered with Mobquet Swoops and Speeders, who had an excellent reputation in repulsorlift vehicle design. [[Engineer/Legends|Engineers]] from both Loronar and Mobquet jointly designed the CS-1. Loronar sold the CS-1 with the E-9 for an additional 12,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="METOSP4" />
